evidence_state_descriptions.detector_disagreement: At least one applicable active detector was positive and at least one was negative.
evidence_state_descriptions.insufficient_coverage: No active detector was applicable for this window.
evidence_state_descriptions.multiple_detector_evidence: More than one applicable active detector produced anomaly evidence.
evidence_state_descriptions.no_evidence: At least one active detector was applicable and no active detector produced anomaly evidence; this is not a verified-healthy label.
evidence_state_descriptions.single_detector_evidence: Exactly one applicable active detector produced anomaly evidence.

score_policy: Detector-local scores are preserved with their own semantics; no universal score is defined.
